value.title: Steward
value.line: The only writer of one shared thing.

sections.name: purpose
sections.value: The only seat that writes one shared thing (a file, a schema, a branch). Others send it changes; it applies them.

sections.name: lifecycle
sections.value: Kept while the thing it stewards changes. Compacted when large, after writing memory.

sections.name: keeps
sections.value: The thing it is sole writer of, and memory notes of the changes it applied.

value.text: Is the only writer of the thing its role names; others ask it.
